def best_jobs(jobs):
    items = sorted((end, start, reward) for start, end, reward in jobs)
    n = len(items)
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    ends = [item[0] for item in items]
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        start = items[i - 1][1]
        reward = items[i - 1][2]

        lo = 0
        hi = i - 1
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if ends[mid] <= start:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid
        p = lo

        take = dp[p] + reward
        skip = dp[i - 1]
        dp[i] = take if take > skip else skip

    return dp[n]
